clue.text: Milk, oddly in a way, is as much as one can bear

definitions.text: as much as one can bear

indicators.note: in places the odd letters inside the word for a way

parts.note: a road is a way

indicators.note: oddly picks the first, third and so on letters of the word Milk

explanation.surface: A question of how much milk a person can carry along a road, phrased oddly.
explanation.definitionFit: An armful is the quantity a person can carry in their arms, the most one can bear at once.

clue.text: Mount first of attacks, retaliating against traitor

indicators.note: first of takes the initial letters of attacks, retaliating and against

parts.note: a rat is a betrayer

explanation.surface: Launching the opening assault in revenge on a turncoat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mount' looks like a verb (mount an attack) but is the definition, a mountain.
explanation.definitionFit: The mountain in Turkey where Noah's ark is said to have come to rest.

clue.text: He told a tale of France's grand river

parts.note: mille is French for a thousand, and a grand is a thousand

explanation.surface: A storyteller spoke of a great French river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Miller tells his tale in Chaucer's Canterbury Tales.

clue.text: 1 in 100 associate after work by choice

indicators.note: after places the associate piece and the rest following the work abbreviation

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: in puts the one inside the hundred

parts.note: a ton is a hundred
I is the Roman numeral one
an ally is an associate

explanation.surface: Reads like a statistic: one in a hundred joins a partner after the job, if they choose.
explanation.definitionFit: Done at one's own discretion, voluntarily, rather than by requirement.

clue.text: Confederacy of eleven, assumed to fail?

indicators.note: assumed means taken on, so the word for fail takes in the eleven

parts.note: to die is to fail, as an engine dies
XI is eleven in Roman numerals, and also a team of eleven

explanation.surface: A league of eleven teams thought certain to collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: Dixie is the nickname for the US southern states that formed the Confederacy, eleven in number.

clue.text: Archdeacon querulously admitting defeat

indicators.note: admitting means the two words take in the answer's letters, spanning their join

explanation.surface: A peevish senior cleric grudgingly concedes he has lost.
explanation.definitionFit: To overcome or vanquish is the verb sense shared by both words.

clue.text: Cliff goes round tip of west Ireland disfiguring the landscape

indicators.note: goes round means the cliff word encloses the other pieces

parts.note: a crag is a steep rock face

indicators.note: tip of here takes the final letter of west, its end tip

parts.note: Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: A cliff path circles the end of western Ireland, spoiling the scenery.
explanation.definitionFit: Pocking the ground with holes, as shelling does, mars the landscape.

clue.text: Take home books about foundations of the West

indicators.note: about means the books abbreviation goes round the other letters

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a set of books

indicators.note: in a down clue the foundations are the bottom letters, the last of the and West

explanation.surface: Borrowing library books on the origins of Western civilisation.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn as clear profit after deductions, as in take-home pay.

clue.text: Victorious, like an exemplary public schoolboy of old?

definitions.text: like an exemplary public schoolboy of old?
definitions.meaning: a well-behaved pupil in the days of corporal punishment never got the cane

explanation.walkthrough: A British public school is a fee-paying private school, where caning was once routine.
explanation.definitionFit: Never having lost means undefeated, and a good boy escaped a thrashing.

clue.text: Others not as unsettled

parts.note: the rest means the others
less means not as much

explanation.surface: Other people are less disturbed by it.
explanation.definitionFit: Fidgety and unable to settle or relax.

clue.text: Very much welcomes large grant

indicators.note: welcomes means the phrase for very much takes the letter for large inside it

parts.note: a lot means very much
L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Someone greatly appreciates a big award of money.
explanation.definitionFit: To grant something is to assign or allocate it, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Doctor buys extra radiography equipment

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters of buys extra are rearranged

explanation.surface: A medic purchases additional kit for the scanning department.
explanation.definitionFit: These vacuum tubes generate the radiation used in radiography, so they are its equipment.

clue.text: Exciting era in which submariner happened on way to measure current

indicators.note: in which says the following pieces sit inside the stirred-up letters
exciting means stirring up, so the letters of era are shaken into a new order

parts.note: Captain Nemo commands the submarine Nautilus in Jules Verne's novel
met means happened on, came across

explanation.surface: A thrilling period when a sailor stumbled across a method for gauging flow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' suggests electricity, but here it is moving air: Captain Nemo of Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues is the submariner.
explanation.definitionFit: The instrument gauges wind speed, and wind is an air current, so it is a way to measure one.

clue.text: Arrange sources of love and laughter for everyone

indicators.note: arrange tells us to reorder the three initial letters
sources of means the starting letters of love, and and laughter

explanation.surface: A wish to provide love and laughter for the whole world.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means every person, as in a toast for each one present.

clue.text: Model modern mum snatching a minute

indicators.note: snatching means the reshaped letters grab the a and hold it inside
model as a verb means shape, so the letters of modern mum are reshaped

explanation.surface: A fashion model who is a modern mother grabs sixty seconds to herself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'minute' looks like a unit of time, but it is a written note.
explanation.definitionFit: A minute is a written note or record, as in office memos and meeting minutes.

clue.text: Tin containing a beer full of energy and cheer

indicators.note: containing means the symbol for tin holds the a inside it

parts.note: Sn is the chemical symbol for tin

indicators.note: full of means the beer brand has the energy letter put inside it

parts.note: Guinness is a famous Irish stout
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A can of stout described as invigorating and uplifting.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means hopeful cheerfulness, an optimistic temperament, so it matches cheer as a noun.

clue.text: Gran opted to act as child's sponsor

indicators.note: to act suggests a performance or role, so the letters are recast into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A grandmother chose to stand up for a child at the christening.
explanation.definitionFit: At a baptism this person vouches for the child, a sponsor in church terms.

clue.text: Eulogising extremely good woman with lines of great delicacy

indicators.note: extremely takes the outermost letters of Eulogising

parts.note: she is a pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: Praising a fine woman's verse lines as very refined.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes something thin and fragile, as fine porcelain or a pale paint finish.

clue.text: Employ brainiest Manx folk from Madrid?

indicators.note: employ suggests putting the letters to new use in a different order
a Manx cat has no tail, so the word brainiest loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Hire the cleverest people from the Isle of Man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Manx' (tailless, like the Isle of Man cat) cuts the last letter from brainiest before 'Employ' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Madrid is in Spain on the Iberian peninsula, so its people are an example; the query flags the example.

clue.text: Rhubarb wolfed down? I approve!

parts.note: to gobble food is to wolf it down
the ego is the self, the I
to OK something is to approve it

explanation.surface: Someone eats a rhubarb dish greedily and gives it a thumbs-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rhubarb' is British slang for nonsense, the background mutter actors make on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are words for meaningless talk or jargon-filled nonsense.

clue.text: The crux of recent research

indicators.note: of means the answer is taken from within the two words

explanation.surface: Identifies the key point of some new findings.
explanation.definitionFit: The heart or central point of a matter, its core.

clue.text: Famous sons delay leaving

parts.note: S is short for son or sons
to tarry is to linger, putting off departure

explanation.surface: Celebrity children who hang about before going.
explanation.definitionFit: Full of stars, as in a starry cast, celebrated and well known.

clue.text: Man from island wearing sweater inside out

indicators.note: wearing means the island letter is clothed by the remaining pair
inside out means the inner letters of sweater are thrown out, leaving its ends

explanation.surface: An islander has put his jumper on the wrong way.
explanation.definitionFit: A knight or baronet is addressed by this title, so it stands for a man.

clue.text: Roughly laminate covers of prewar Chambers?

indicators.note: roughly means the letters are rearranged loosely
covers of means the outside letters of prewar

explanation.surface: Instructions to coarsely laminate the covers of a pre-war copy of Chambers dictionary.
explanation.walkthrough: Chambers is a well-known British dictionary, which is the misdirection; the question mark signals the legislative chambers.
explanation.definitionFit: A legislature such as Westminster consists of chambers, the Commons and the Lords.

clue.text: Young woman, over time, stays fresh

indicators.note: over here means the girl word lies over and around the time letter

parts.note: lass is a young woman

explanation.surface: A girl, after a while, keeps her youthful looks.
explanation.definitionFit: Food or flowers that endure keep their freshness, so the verb means to survive.

clue.text: Policy of alliance regularly dismissed

indicators.note: regularly dismissed throws out every other letter of alliance, keeping the remainder

explanation.surface: A coalition's agenda is repeatedly thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: A party line is its official policy.

clue.text: They hope to pass morning in Spain surrounded by old lovers

indicators.note: surrounded by means the morning, in and Spain pieces sit inside the word for old lovers

parts.note: exes are former partners
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: A holiday morning in Spain hemmed in by former partners.
explanation.definitionFit: Candidates sitting a test are hoping for a passing mark.

clue.text: Dorothy Parker missing land she adores

parts.note: Dot is a short form of the name Dorothy

indicators.note: missing means the word for a piece of land is taken from the surname

parts.note: a park is a piece of land

explanation.surface: Dorothy Parker, the American wit, is absent from a country she loves.
explanation.definitionFit: One who dotes is a fond admirer, a person who adores someone; the pronoun fits a doting woman.

clue.text: Most rich drunks finally repent

parts.note: lushes are heavy drinkers

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of repent

explanation.surface: Wealthy alcoholics at last feel remorse.
explanation.definitionFit: Lush means rich or luxuriant, so the superlative is richest.

clue.text: Warm brief statement is broadcast

indicators.note: is broadcast means the word is spoken over the air, so we hear it

parts.note: a summary is a brief statement of main points

explanation.surface: A short, cordial announcement goes out on air.
explanation.definitionFit: Typical of the hottest season, so warm in weather terms.
